source='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend contiguous diagonal runs of length at least two to the nearest
    border or existing non-background object cell."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    src = [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = src[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r-dr, c-dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and src[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue  # not the beginning of this diagonal run
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and src[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue
                # Extend at both ends. Other original colors act as blockers.
                for sr, sc, step_r, step_c in ((r-dr, c-dc, -dr, -dc), (rr, cc, dr, dc)):
                    while 0 <= sr < h and 0 <= sc < w and src[sr][sc] == bg:
                        out[sr][sc] = color
                        sr += step_r
                        sc += step_c
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p, p.exists())
